fetch_observation_boundary.response_headers: iterate the Fetch Headers object once into a lowercase plain string map, reject any key/value with an unpaired surrogate, RFC8785-JCS serialize it, and apply response_headers_max_bytes to those exact normalized UTF-8 bytes; raw wire order and duplicate lines are neither observable nor claimed
fetch_observation_boundary.response_body: incrementally count and buffer the bytes yielded by the Fetch Response body stream after Fetch content-decoding; apply the operation response cap to those bytes and hash them before text decoding
fetch_observation_boundary.content_encoding: pass requires content-encoding absent or exact identity; any other value records the normalized headers and capped yielded body/charge then triggers provider drift
fetch_observation_boundary.tls_hostname: the evidence field is the exact lowercase URL hostname api.anthropic.com supplied to Node Fetch and its default certificate verifier, proven by the frozen origin, no proxy/custom CA/DNS override, redirect:error, and exact final Response.url; it is not represented as a raw socket observation
fetch_observation_boundary.certificate_verification: Node default TLS certificate and hostname verification must succeed; disabling or replacing it is forbidden

trial_deadline.clock: one monotonic nanosecond clock shared by the complete trial
trial_deadline.deadline: trial_start_ns + 300000000000 with checked Number-safe or bigint arithmetic
trial_deadline.operation_abort_ms: min(the operation's fixed count_timeout_ms or create_timeout_ms, remaining_before_operation_ms)
trial_deadline.nonpositive_remaining: do not send; terminate the scheduled trial as timed_out empty-zero
trial_deadline.boundary_attribution: an AbortError at the trial deadline is a trial timeout; an earlier fixed Count deadline is a campaign-stopping Count failure; an earlier fixed Create deadline is an ordinary terminal-zero Create outcome
trial_deadline.post_response_expiry: if a valid final end_turn text response arrives but validation, transcript fsync, or answer fsync is not complete before the trial deadline, retain the exact successful provider event and raw answer only in the private transcript/archive, classify the trial timed_out, expose an ordinary empty-zero blind answer/hash, and never fabricate a failed Create

network_configuration.accepted_tls_hostname: the frozen verifier-input hostname must exactly equal api.anthropic.com under fetch_observation_boundary.tls_hostname

relay_failure_outcomes.response_or_header_overflow: record any charge, assign scheduled trial zero, stop campaign
relay_failure_outcomes.final_url_or_tls_mismatch: record any charge, assign scheduled trial zero, stop campaign

isolation.sandbox_honesty: macOS sandbox is not claimed to provide a domain-specific IP allowlist; endpoint restriction is the narrow audited relay boundary
isolation.sandbox_profile_policy: exact approval-bound profile bytes; no widening, fallback, or ambient exception

pre_provider_proofs: worker cannot connect to controlled sentinel
isolation.pre_provider_proof_scope: before the first provider request of any kind, including Count Tokens, prove the worker and every descendant satisfy all three checks
isolation.fixture_stage_order: persist and fsync every answer and transcript before loading owner fixtures, required handoffs, or human rubric material
isolation.block_integrity: verify frozen checkout, tree, and fixture hashes before and after every comparison block
isolation.failure_policy: stop campaign when containment or endpoint restriction cannot be proved

provider_authorization.timing: before the first provider request of any kind, including Count Tokens
provider_authorization.remaining_enforced_limit_micro_usd: exact nonnegative Number-safe integer equal to remaining_enforced_limit_cents * 10000 with checked multiplication

reservation_algorithm.before_each_create: obtain successful Count Tokens for the exact create semantic body
reservation_algorithm.send_guard: do not send unless known actual plus permanently consumed ambiguous plus the new outstanding reservation remains strictly below 20,000,000 input tokens, 2,000,000 output tokens, 90,000,000 runner micro-USD, and remaining_enforced_limit_cents * 10000 micro-USD; equality reaches a ceiling and stops before Create
reservation_algorithm.ceiling_comparison: integer arithmetic with no rounding down

reconciliation_algorithm.successful_response: replace its outstanding reservation with every actual billable token category and actual cost; nonzero cache usage remains drift but still consumes both ledgers
reconciliation_algorithm.actual_over_reservation: record actual usage and charge, assign trial zero, and stop immediately
reconciliation_algorithm.ambiguous_transport: permanently consume the full input, output, and cost reservation in the ambiguous-reservation ledger; never release it or substitute zero actual usage; the trial is ordinary terminal-zero and the campaign continues only while every strict ceiling remains satisfied
reconciliation_algorithm.create_deadline: a post-send Create AbortError with no accepted response is an ordinary terminal-zero trial, not a retry; permanently consume the full reservation in the ambiguous-reservation ledger and continue only while every strict ceiling remains satisfied
reconciliation_algorithm.count_deadline: a Count Tokens deadline is a Count failure and stops the campaign before Create; Count requests carry no Create reservation
reconciliation_algorithm.non_2xx_create_response: an error response is ordinary terminal-zero; permanently consume the full reservation instead of inferring absent usage from an unapproved error-body shape, and continue only while every strict ceiling remains satisfied
reconciliation_algorithm.failed_known_response: record and consume all actual usage/cost returned by the provider before applying terminal policy
reconciliation_algorithm.unknown_usage_or_cost: blocking unknown; assign trial zero and stop

reservation_arithmetic.count_join: Create counted_input_tokens equals its immediately preceding successful Count input_tokens
reservation_arithmetic.usage_total: every known provider total equals the exact sum of its recorded token categories
reservation_arithmetic.ledger: known actual usage/cost plus permanently consumed ambiguous reservations and outstanding reservations reconcile every Count/Create and diagnostic call exactly once

final response URL and TLS hostname

stop_policy.classification: record every condition ID whose trigger is true at the first stopping observation; first_stop_condition_id is the lowest numeric matching ID, simultaneous overlaps are not discarded, and no later observation may replace or reprioritize that set

conditions.trigger: protected base, src, package, lock, frozen v2, schema, validator, repository, fixture, prompt, expected evidence, grading, threshold, temperature, schedule, tool-call, timeout, or cost binding drifts
any production source, public behavior, dependency, package content, build config, graph/index/query semantic, token budget, or timeout must change
any CI workflow change beyond the one approval-bound offline self-test is required
any compatibility alias, wrapper, fallback, duplicate implementation, graph override, restored --no-html, or hidden configuration is required
the exact default Madar MCP cannot use the retained accepted bundle without drift or rebuild
Graphify identity/environment/argv, ten-tool/six-resource surface, directed-runtime coercion, code-only precondition, zero build-provider tokens, query-log denial, or network isolation differs

provider rejects a frozen temperature; model, request-template, thinking, service-tier, geography, rate, usage-category, cache, stop/content/usage-shape, or billing behavior drifts; or audited narrow relay and credential isolation cannot be proved
host/binary/sandbox binding changes or cannot prove full child-process containment/RSS
a repository, owner, patch, or result hash differs
a generated path, hidden fixture, prior answer, arm identity, or rubric leaks before its permitted stage
reviewer independence, two sealed scores, required adjudication, or pre-reveal hashes are missing
any scheduled trial is retried, replaced, dropped, or regraded after reveal
any token or USD ceiling is reached or any blocking value is unknown
publication, release, Registry metadata, a tag, main, or external-validation work becomes necessary
